stops.location: North Las Vegas, NV - East Lake Mead South Boulevard

stops.caption: MGM Grand · checked in & parked
stops.note: After North LV Supercharge (~6:07pm): check-in ~6:15pm, then on foot from ~6:30pm with friends. Not overnight — sleep after Strip evening.

stops.caption: MGM Grand · overnight
stops.note: Slept after evening walk (last Strip photos ~10:32pm PT). Wake next morning.

stops.caption: MGM Grand · second night
stops.note: Second hotel night before leaving Vegas for Page / Lake Powell.

stops.location: Las Vegas, NV - South Maryland Parkway

stops.caption: Camped at Page / Lake Powell
stops.subcaption: Overnight rest · morning drive to Horseshoe Bend
stops.note: Arrived ~midnight MST Dec 17 after Page Supercharge; overnight camp (not on-foot). Morning: drive to Horseshoe Bend parking — do not treat the sleep gap as walking.

stops.caption: Horseshoe Bend parking
stops.subcaption: Morning drive from camp · short walk to rim
stops.note: Drive from Page camp (~5.6 mi), park, then walk ~0.6 mi to the overlook for photos.

stops.caption: Halt · Sedona viewpoint
stops.subcaption: ~5:44pm — sat a while, then drove back
stops.note: Dec 17 ~5:44pm MST: reached Mystic Trail / Sedona viewpoint, spent time, then returned. Not on-foot — halt + drive.

stops.caption: Halt · 401 Historic Rte 66 Williams
stops.subcaption: 30 minutes — changed plans, headed back to Vegas
stops.note: Plus code 6RX5+RP Williams AZ. Brief 30 min stop before returning to Vegas instead of another Arizona camp night.

stops.location: Las Vegas, NV — Strip hotel stay
stops.caption: Las Vegas hotel · one more night
stops.note: Second Vegas hotel night after aborting another Arizona camp.

stops.caption: Camped in Death Valley
stops.note: Death Valley camping night (photo cluster).

stops.caption: Camped in Mojave National Preserve
stops.note: Mojave camping night before LA.

stops.caption: LA hotel · Koreatown
stops.note: Plus code 3P52+2V. Hub for two nights — roam from hotel and return. Not Redondo Beach SC.

stops.caption: LA hotel · Koreatown
stops.note: Second night at 3206 W 8th St before leaving north toward Malibu / Central Coast.

stops.location: Friend Radaya — 841 Saint Rufina Ln, Morgan Hill, CA
stops.caption: Friend Radaya's · overnight
stops.note: Dec 23 ~10:30pm PT arrival; slept at Radaya's home (841 Saint Rufina Ln, Morgan Hill). Dec 24 ~11am breakfast photos (IMG_2224+) are at this pin — Cabrillo / Sand City beach photos are a separate visit, not the sleep location.

stops.location: Amit's home — Mansion Grove, Santa Clara
stops.caption: Friend Amit's · Santa Clara
stops.subcaption: Night 1 · hub for Bay Area days
stops.note: After SF outing Dec 24 evening. Overnight rest here — morning ducks walk nearby is on-foot; Stanford and other day trips are by car from this hub.

stops.location: Amit's home — Mansion Grove, Santa Clara
stops.caption: Friend Amit's · Santa Clara
stops.note: Second night at Amit's after Dec 25 roam (Stanford by car, coast photos). Leave Dec 26.

stops.location: Northern CA coast — Trinidad / Arcata camping
stops.caption: Camped on the Northern CA coast
stops.subcaption: BBQ & chair sleep · up next morning
stops.note: Dec 26 evening arrival (Trinidad coast photos ~6:30pm PT). Eureka/Arcata Supercharges are ignored — top-ups while settled at camp. Dec 27 ~2am PT BBQ / sleeping-on-chair cluster (IMG_9784+). Leave ~10am PT toward Crescent City.

stops.caption: Camped on the Klamath / Redwood coast
stops.subcaption: One night on the way north
stops.note: Photo cluster near Brookings / CA–OR Redwood coast (after Crescent City, before Coos Bay).

stops.caption: Camped at Tillicum Beach
stops.note: Tillicum Beach Campground overnight (Yachats/Waldport photo cluster) before the final push home.

stops.caption: Home · Bellevue
stops.subcaption: Back from the road trip · Dec 29 morning
stops.note: Arrived Bellevue home morning Dec 29 (IMG_3456 ~10:16am PT). Hub for WA days — not still en route to NYE.

stops.caption: Home · Bellevue
stops.note: Pulls the path home after the Dec 29 evening Magnolia / Seattle waterfront outing so beach pins are short home→out→home drives, not a Rochester→island corridor.

stops.caption: Home · Bellevue
stops.note: Dec 30–31 mostly at home (local Costco / errands only). Leave evening Dec 31 for the New Year Airbnb.
Board Mukilteo–Clinton ferry for New Year’s Eve (not a drive over the water).
Whidbey Island side after the ferry crossing.

stops.caption: Airbnb · New Year's
